ContractNLI:e671a984356facb0c0666809e219: The Receiving Party shall take all practical steps to keep the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information confidential and shall restrict access to the Confidential Information to those agents and professional advisers to whom disclosure is necessary in pursuit of the Approved Purpose.
